data.raw_text:
The Land Transportation Office (LTO) has begun issuing traffic violation tickets to e-bike and e-trike drivers traveling along certain national roads in Metro Manila whose number will grow this week.

This came after the LTO announced that it will enforce the ban on e-trikes and e-bikes on major thoroughfares in Metro Manila in 2026.

[5:44PM] #Shomolu #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic movement from Adekunle intersection linking the 3rd Mainland bridge inward and outward is free at present. 
Makoko and Panti junction are in order and without delays.
Movement onward journey Alagomeji is good to go. 

Movement aproaching Sabo is steady, due to the traffic alternation. 
St Agnes inward Unilag junction,  YabaTech, WAEC down to Jibowu is moving steadily. 

Movement underneath the Jibowu bridge is free at the moment. 
Jibowu inward Yaba phase 1and2 have smooth vehicular flow.
The strectch of Muritala Muhammad way down to Oyingbo is good to go. 

Oyingbo inwand Iddo through Otto is good, likewise the return journey. 
Oyingbo inwand Ile-lle is slightly busy due to market activities. 
Kano st inward Apena Cemetary down to Adekunle is moving steadily. 

There are no impediments in these areas, and our officers are present at various important locations, doing the needful.

#FollowLASTMA
